details: This package is a self-described callback canary used to verify where code lands in a Wix server-side-rendering (SSR) pipeline. It performs no install-time hook; the beacon runs when the module is imported. index.js detects its execution context (Node SSR builder vs. browser builder vs. viewer-platform worker) and issues a single out-of-band GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/27264a2c-7b73-4b9c-99d8-dfc9681cd068/<context-label> with credentials:'omit'. worker-canary.js does the same from a worker context and sets an inert marker global (__WIX_VIEWER_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE_CANARY__). media-canary.txt is a script fragment that fetches hxxps://pea7692krk3ua1rcthnr5uifvg[.]ssrf-check[.]wix[.]com/builder-component-media-override-rce for a component-media override / SSRF probe. The only data transmitted is a static context label: the code reads no environment variables, no credentials, no files, no tokens, and sends no request body. Package footprint is four files (~1.8 KB): index.js, worker-canary.js, media-canary.txt, package.json.
